newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amplats says talks on merger continuing.
newsitem.headline: Amplats says talks on merger continuing.

text.p: Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd (Amplats) said on Wednesday negotiations on the restructuring of the group and the merger of its four existing companies into one was continuing.

In a cautionary announcement, the corporation said shareholders in Amplats, Rustenburg Platinum Holdings Ltd (Rusplat), Lebowa Platinum Mines Ltd (Leplat), Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd (PP Rust) should exercise caution in share dealings until a further announcement was made.

Amplats said on April 15 that the merger of its three mines and the corporation supported the group's strategy of moving its operations down the cost curve and increasing operational flexibility to take full advantage of market conditions.
The merger, together with the development of a new mine at Boschkoppie and expansion of PP Rust's concentrator, would enhance Amplats position as world leader in platinum, the company said.
